query: Build out the guide for MD-704 — it's a Pillar ticket for a Preventive Maintenance Strategy guide with a Confluence draft linked in the description. Get it on /resources/guides.
expected_behavior: Runs the marketing-pages preflight guard (content.sh check-repo) and refuses to write if the checkout is not marketing-pages
Reads the Jira ticket via acli, fetches the linked Confluence draft and its images, and confirms the slug (e.g. preventive-maintenance-strategy) with the user before uploading

Resolves the page destination, route, registration mode, and permitted components from the repo's content profile (content.sh pipeline guides) rather than a hardcoded pages/ path, and stops with a message naming what it needed if the repo declares none

Composes a hand-built Vue page at the resolved destination from the guide component palette (BaseSection, callout, alternative grids, SectionAccordion) rather than a Nuxt-Content markdown file or the forbidden ::fImg/::image-text blocks

Uploads the body, OG, and card images to the folders the profile declares for each role, taking the next free card index, and writes each image's `reference` value verbatim rather than hand-assembling a CDN path — body and card images relative, OG as the full URL

Wires useDynamicMeta (title, keyword-rich description, route path, the OG reference), keeps TOC ids in sync with BaseSection ids, uses only tron- tokens (no arbitrary Tailwind values), and registers the guide in the declared index file when the profile says registration is manual
Produces copy with no em dashes (Facilitron voice), runs the verification loop (renders the route on this worktree, prose-lint, a11y-scan, em-dash grep), and cleans up /tmp and dropped-in sources
